name: DNR: Do Not Reciprocate
source:
A yandere romance visual novel about Niko, a sickly man hospitalized for the nth time, and three doctors who may or may not indulge in medical malpractice.

[From [url=https://plutonicore.itch.io/dnr-do-not-reciprocate]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部病娇恋爱视觉小说，讲述不知第多少次住院的体弱青年尼科，与三名或许正在大搞医疗违规行为的医生之间的故事。

[摘自[url=https://plutonicore.itch.io/dnr-do-not-reciprocate]itch.io[/url]]
